WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(CASE WHEN m.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND m.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL AND m.geomdeltamm != 0 THEN m.facetresmm::float / m.geomdeltamm::float ELSE NULL END) as site_avg_ratio
  FROM sites s
  JOIN scanmesh m ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_avg_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  WHERE site_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
filtered_sites AS (
  SELECT sr.insurstat, sr.site_avg_ratio, sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sr.site_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND sr.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_avg_ratio) as average_ratio, COUNT(*) as kept_sites_count, AVG(site_avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) as average_excess
FROM filtered_sites
GROUP BY insurstat
